subject: Future Tech
title: Variational Quantum Algorithms
description: A quick, practical guide to Variational Quantum Algorithms.

hook.text: Today's quantum machines are noisy. Variational algorithms were invented to extract useful results from flawed chips.

buildup.text: They work as a hybrid: the quantum chip proposes a solution and a classical computer tunes the parameters.

discovery.text: The quantum-classical loop repeats until it converges on the best answer, like tuning a radio to find a signal.

twist.text: Critics worry these algorithms get stuck in local minima and may never scale to deliver true quantum advantage.

climax.text: Still, variational methods power the most practical quantum experiments running today on real cloud hardware.

punchline.text: Imperfect machines solving real problems right now.

quiz.question: What makes variational quantum algorithms 'hybrid'?
options: They combine quantum and classical computing in a loop
They run on photons and electrons
